components.text:
Circle: small circle, ritual chalk.

Takes a beaten wild werewolf into your pack as a brother.

Only a werewolf, of any rank, can perform it. The wolf (a beast or a survivalist, not an Alpha, a trial boss or one already bonded) must be within 4 blocks of the centre at half health or less. It is not an ingredient.
You and your pack can have only so many brothers (a server setting). A refusal tells you why and gives the ingredients back.
